name: Garnet Construction Limited
about: Garnet Construction Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. The company engages in residential, commercial, industrial, and retail projects, including mass housing and cluster redevelopment projects, as well as develops, manages, and leases industrial plots and sheds. It also provides real estate related services for residential, industrial, commercial open plots, and bungalows. The company serves individuals and institutional customers. Garnet Construction Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
